notes: support=official: documented in current first-party Google help.
support=working: undocumented (or no longer documented) but consistently observed to work.
support=unreliable: works intermittently or only in specific verticals; never emitted by the generator.
support=deprecated: removed by Google; kept so older third-party lists can be checked against it.
generate=false operators are never emitted by templates regardless of support state.

operators.name: Exact phrase
operators.description: Match the enclosed words in that exact order. The single most useful precision tool.
caveats: Google may still return close variants; combine with intext: for stricter body matching.

operators.name: Exclude
operators.description: Remove results containing the term, phrase or operator value that follows the minus sign.
caveats: No space between - and the term.
Can be combined with other operators, e.g. -inurl:login.

operators.name: Either / or
operators.description: Match pages containing either alternative. Must be upper-case.
caveats: Lower-case 'or' is treated as an ordinary word.
Group alternatives with parentheses to avoid ambiguity.

operators.name: Pipe (OR alias)
operators.description: Vertical bar behaves like OR.
caveats: Not documented in Google's help; the generator emits OR instead.

operators.name: And
operators.description: Require both terms. Google already ANDs terms implicitly, so it is rarely needed.
caveats: Redundant in most queries; implicit AND is the default.

operators.name: Grouping
operators.description: Parentheses group alternatives so operators apply to the whole group.
caveats: Undocumented but consistently honoured; keep nesting shallow.

operators.name: Wildcard
operators.description: Placeholder for one or more unknown words, most useful inside an exact phrase.
caveats: Outside quotes it is usually ignored.

operators.name: Site restriction
operators.description: Restrict results to a domain, sub-domain pattern or path prefix.
caveats: No scheme (http://) in the value.
Combine with -site: to carve out noisy hosts.

operators.name: File type
operators.description: Only return documents of the given extension.
caveats: One extension per operator; use OR groups for several.
No leading dot.

operators.name: Extension (filetype alias)
operators.description: Alias of filetype:.
caveats: Undocumented alias; the generator emits filetype: instead.

operators.name: Before date
operators.description: Results published before the given date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).
caveats: Relies on Google's estimated publish date, which can be wrong.

operators.name: After date
operators.description: Results published after the given date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).
caveats: Relies on Google's estimated publish date, which can be wrong.

operators.name: In title
operators.description: The word or phrase must appear in the page title.
caveats: No longer listed in Google's help page but consistently works.
Applies only to the next word unless quoted.

operators.name: All in title
operators.description: Every following word must appear in the title. Cannot be combined with other operators.
caveats: Swallows the rest of the query; the generator uses intitle: instead.

operators.name: In URL
operators.description: The word must appear somewhere in the URL.
caveats: Undocumented; phrases with punctuation are matched loosely.

operators.name: All in URL
operators.description: Every following word must appear in the URL. Cannot be combined with other operators.
caveats: Swallows the rest of the query; the generator uses inurl: instead.

operators.name: In page text
operators.description: The word or phrase must appear in the body text rather than title or URL.
caveats: Undocumented; behaves like a stricter exact phrase.

operators.name: All in text
operators.description: Every following word must appear in the body text. Cannot be combined with other operators.
caveats: Swallows the rest of the query; the generator uses intext: instead.

operators.name: In anchor text
operators.description: Matches pages linked with the given anchor text.
caveats: Sampled data only; results are inconsistent.

operators.name: All in anchor text
operators.description: Every word must appear in anchor text of inbound links.
caveats: Sampled data only; results are inconsistent.

operators.name: Proximity
operators.description: Both terms must appear within N words of each other.
caveats: Undocumented; must be upper-case with the number in parentheses.
Works best with quoted phrases on both sides.

operators.name: Hashtag
operators.description: Search for hashtags across indexed social content.
caveats: Coverage of social networks is partial.

operators.name: Social handle
operators.description: Documented by Google for searching social media, but in practice the @ is often dropped.
caveats: Listed in Google's help but results are inconsistent; quote the handle ("@alice42") or use site: instead.

operators.name: Number range
operators.description: Match numbers within a range.

operators.name: Price
operators.description: Match a price.

operators.name: Definition
operators.description: Show a dictionary definition.

operators.name: Weather
operators.description: Weather widget for a location.

operators.name: Stock quote
operators.description: Stock information for a ticker.

operators.name: Map
operators.description: Map results for a location.

operators.name: News source
operators.description: Restrict Google News results to a publisher.
caveats: Only meaningful in the News vertical; ignored in web search.

operators.name: Location
operators.description: Historically restricted results by location.
caveats: Largely ignored in web search today; add the location as a plain keyword instead.

operators.name: Image size
operators.description: Image search by exact dimensions.
caveats: Image search only.

operators.name: Related sites
operators.description: Sites similar to the given domain. Google removed this operator in 2023.
caveats: Removed; still appears in many third-party lists.

operators.name: Cached copy
operators.description: Google's cached copy of a page. Google removed the cache feature and its documentation in 2024.
caveats: No longer works. Use the Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) instead.

operators.name: Page info
operators.description: Summary information about a URL. Removed in 2017.
caveats: Removed; behaves like a plain keyword search.

operators.name: Inbound links
operators.description: Pages linking to a URL. Removed in 2017.
caveats: Removed; use a backlink tool or search the quoted URL instead.

operators.name: Date range (Julian)
operators.description: Julian-day date range. Superseded by before:/after:.
caveats: Use after: and before: with ISO dates.

operators.name: Force include (legacy)
operators.description: Forced exact inclusion of a word. Repurposed for Google+ in 2011 and never restored.
caveats: Use exact-phrase quotes instead.

operators.name: Synonym (legacy)
operators.description: Include synonyms. Removed in 2013 because synonyms are applied automatically.
caveats: Ignored by Google.

operators.name: Phonebook (legacy)
operators.description: Phone directory lookup. Removed in 2010.
caveats: Removed.

operators.name: Blog post author (legacy)
operators.description: Blog Search author filter. Blog Search was shut down in 2014.
caveats: Removed.
